    # Trim to appropriate size for symmetric convolution
    mid = len(g) // 2
    g_trimmed = g[mid - n//2:mid + n//2]
    
    # Compute norms using more accurate piecewise integration
    g_abs = np.abs(g_trimmed)
    
    # ||g||₂² using trapezoidal-like piecewise integration
    g_norm_2_squared = 0.0
    if len(g_abs) > 1:

    # Avoid division by zero
